instructions: Read old_text vs new_text for each entry and fill in should_approve, error_kind, reason, confirmed_by and confirmed_at. The proposed_* fields are intent-derived starting points and may be wrong -- that is why this file exists. Entries left unconfirmed are excluded from the study.

confirmations.old_text: The Parties wish to explore a potential commercial arrangement concerning shared use of port-side logistics capacity (the “Purpose”). In connection with the Purpose, each Party may disclose Confidential Information to the other. It is hereby mutually agreed and understood by and between the Parties hereto that this Agreement governs the treatment of such information.
confirmations.new_text: The Parties wish to explore a potential commercial arrangement concerning shared use of port-side logistics capacity (the “Purpose”). In connection with the Purpose, each Party may disclose Confidential Information to the other. The Parties agree that this Agreement governs the treatment of such information.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Removes legalese padding. No obligation is altered.

confirmations.old_text: “Confidential Information” means any information disclosed by one Party (the “Disclosing Party”) to the other (the “Receiving Party”), whether orally, in writing or in any other form, that is designated as confidential or that would reasonably be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. It includes commercial terms, pricing, operational data, customer lists, and technical information.
confirmations.new_text: “Confidential Information” means any information disclosed by one Party (the “Disclosing Party”) to the other (the “Receiving Party”), whether orally, in writing or in any other form, that is designated as confidential or that would reasonably be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. It includes: commercial terms pricing operational data customer lists technical information

confirmations.old_text: The Receiving Party shall keep the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information confidential, shall use it solely for the Purpose, and shall not disclose it to any third party without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent. The Receiving Party shall protect the Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it applies to its own confidential information, and in no event less than a reasonable degree of care.
confirmations.new_text: The Receiving Party shall keep the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information confidential, shall use it solely for the Purpose, and shall not disclose it to any third party without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent. The Receiving Party shall handle Confidential Information appropriately.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Keeps the shape of the clause while removing its content. The measurable standard -- the same degree of care as for its own confidential information, and never less than reasonable care -- is replaced by 'appropriately', which is unenforceable.

confirmations.old_text: The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, officers and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose, provided that each such recipient is bound by obligations of confidentiality no less protective than those in this Agreement. The Receiving Party remains responsible for any breach by such recipients.
confirmations.new_text: The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, officers, and advisers on a need-to-know basis for the Purpose, provided they are bound by equivalent confidentiality obligations. The Receiving Party remains responsible for any breach by such recipients.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Style only. The need-to-know limit and flow-down duty are intact.

confirmations.old_text: This Agreement commences on the date first written above and continues for two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party on thirty (30) days' written notice. The obligations of confidentiality in Clause 3 shall survive expiry or termination and continue for a further three (3) years.
confirmations.new_text: This Agreement commences on the date first written above and continues for two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party on thirty (30) days' written notice. The obligations of confidentiality in Clause 3 shall survive expiry or termination and continue for a further six (6) months.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Cuts post-termination protection from three years to six months. Commercially sensitive information disclosed under this NDA loses protection while it is still current.

confirmations.old_text: On written request by the Disclosing Party, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all materials containing Confidential Information, and shall confirm in writing that it has done so. The Receiving Party may retain one copy to the extent required by law or its internal compliance policies, subject to continuing confidentiality obligations.
confirmations.new_text: On written request by the Disclosing Party, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all materials containing Confidential Information, and shall confirm in writing that it has done so. The Receiving Party may retain one copy of Confidential Information if required by law or its internal compliance policies, provided it remains subject to the continuing confidentiality obligations set out in this Agreement.
confirmations.proposed_reason: Clarity only. The single-copy exception and its condition survive.

confirmations.old_text: Nothing in this Agreement grants either Party any licence or right in the other's intellectual property, and nothing obliges either Party to proceed with any transaction. Each Party bears its own costs in connection with the Purpose. Executed by the duly authorised representatives of the Parties on 02/03/2026.
confirmations.new_text: Nothing in this Agreement grants either Party any intellectual property rights, nor does it oblige either Party to proceed with any transaction. Each Party bears its own costs in connection with the Purpose. Executed by the duly authorised representatives of the Parties on 2 March 2026.
